historical_exposure.method: Known historical indices plus exact original RGB SHA-256, including prepared and gated registrations and current development/diagnostic views. The physical rooms were studied before; adjacent images may depict the same surfaces.

stats.primary: hierarchical paired physical-scene and seed resampling within dataset
stats.ratio: candidate/native three-seed median per room and arithmetic equal-room mean
stats.pass_condition: estimate and 95th percentile <=1.01 independently on both metrics per dataset

timing: Fresh CPU-resident model/inputs through placement, 40 real updates, final FP32 unprojection. GPU-synchronized boundaries. Score and instrumentation outside the timer.
